SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P...
& Special Br...
S. D. D. 2588/IV.
Date August 17 1931
18 - 8 - 31

Subject (in full)   Pickets kidnap Japanese

Made by   J. D. S. Umemoto.   Forwarded by   A.B. Km   D.I.

Acting upon instructions of the Officer-in-Charge, Special Branch, I interviewed Mr. I. Arima, an employee of the Insurance Department of the Mitsubishi & Co., No.9 Canton Road, to confirm the report published in the Shanghai Ninpo, dated August 16, 1931, regarding the detention of Mr. Arima by pickets of the Anti-Japanese Association and received from him the following information:-

At 1.30 p.m. August 13, 1931 Mr. Arima proceeded to Loh Ka Doo, Pootung, to investigate the condition of the seized goods stored at the Kung Dah Godown by pickets of the Anti-Japanese Association in connection with the insurance of same. As he was approaching the godown, he was seized by a number of pickets, who, after blindfolding him with a towel, forcibly led him to the Pootung Headquarters of the Association, which is situated in a certain Chinese school, and detained him there.

A person reported to be the Chief of the Pootung Branch of the Association, being satisfied with his explanation to the effect that the object of his visit to the godown was solely on business, apologized for his detention and escorted him to Loh Ka Doo from where he was released at 4.30 p.m.

Although maltreated, Mr. Arima did not suffer any bodily harm.

The matter has been reported to the local Japanese Consulate General.

M Umemoto.
J. D. S.

日期 1931年8月17日
18 - 8 - 31

事由（全称）   纠察队绑架日本人

呈报人   J. D. S. Umemoto（梅本）。   转呈人   A.B. Km   副督察长

遵照特别处主管官员的指示，我约谈了位于广东路9号的三菱公司保险部职员有马伊（I. Arima）先生，以核实1931年8月16日《上海日日新闻》上刊登的关于有马先生被反日协会纠察队拘留的报道，并从他那里获得了以下信息：-

1931年8月13日下午1时30分，有马先生前往浦东陆家嘴，调查由反日协会纠察队扣押并存放在公大仓库的货物状况，此事涉及该批货物的保险事宜。当他接近仓库时，被多名纠察队队员抓住，他们用毛巾蒙住他的眼睛，强行将他带到位于某所中国学校内的该协会浦东总部，并将其拘禁在那里。

据称是协会浦东分部负责人的一名人员，在听取其解释并确信其前往仓库的目的纯属公务后，对其被拘禁一事表示歉意，并护送他返回陆家嘴，他于下午4时30分获释。

尽管受到虐待，有马先生并未遭受任何身体伤害。

此事已报告给日本驻上海总领事馆。

M Umemoto.
J. D. S.

摘录以供纳入8月24日的每日报告中
特别处主管官员。
H.R.
抄送。

档案
9/8
1931年8月22日。

C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2681.
19 - 8 - 31

August 17, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

PICKETS KIDNAP JAPANESE

The Shanghai Nippo (16-8-31)
publishes the following report:-
At 2 p.m. August
13, a Japanese named I Arima, an employee of the
Insurance Department of the Mitsubishi Yoko, was
commissioned to Peetung by the company to investigate
a certain case in connection with an insurance
business. He was confronted by a number of pickets
who questioned him regarding his business and then
took him by force to the 3rd District Police Station
at Peetung. His eyes were covered by the pickets.
He was again subjected to questions by the Police
who released him at 4.30 p.m. after holding a lengthy
conversation with important members of the Anti-
Japanese Association.
Japanese community
is regarding this as very serious matter and is
considered by them as equal to kidnapping.

1931年8月17日。晨间译文。

杂项

纠察队绑架日本人

《上海日日新闻》（1931年8月16日）
刊登如下报道：-
8月
13日下午2时，一名名为有马伊（I Arima）的日本人，系
三菱洋行保险部职员，受公司委派前往浦
东调查一起与保险
业务有关的案件。他遭遇多名纠察队队员，
他们质询其公务事宜，随后强行将他带至浦
东第三区警察分局。他的双眼被纠察队队员蒙住。
警方再次对他进行讯问，并在与反日
协会重要成员进行长时间交谈后，于下午4时30分将其释放。
日本侨民社群
视此事为非常严重的事件，并认为其性质等同于绑架。
